name: Strawberry Vinegar
source:
"Feed me, or I'll reap your soul!"
And with those ridiculous words, my whole life was turned upside down.

Sakuraba Rie, aged nine, is a cynical and grumpy girl who cares little for her fellow classmates, and does not have a single friend.  That is, until a self-proclaimed demon from the deepest, darkest pits of Hell suddenly appears in Rie's kitchen and steals a tray of cookies.  What will happen between these two young girls? Will friendship blossom between them, or perhaps something more?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/407340/Strawberry_Vinegar/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
“喂我，不然我就收割你的灵魂！”
那些可笑的话让我的整个生活发生了翻天覆地的变化。

九岁的樱庭理惠是一个愤世嫉俗、脾气暴躁的女孩，不关心同学，没有一个朋友。直到一个自称来自地狱最深、最黑暗的深渊的恶魔突然出现在理惠的厨房里，并偷走了一盘饼干。这两个年轻女孩之间会发生什么呢？他们之间的友谊会绽放，还是更多？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/407340/Strawberry_Vinegar/]Steam[/url]]
